chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm for a Muhrim to apply kohl that does not contain musk or camphor if he has an eye ailment. And a woman in ihram may apply all kinds of kohl except black kohl for adornment.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman in the state of ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.كُحْلٍ: eyeliner or eye ointment applied to the eyes
key_terms.يَكْتَحِلَ: to apply kohl to the eyes

ai.seo_question: Can a Muhrim or a woman in ihram use kohl while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the use of kohl during ihram. It permits medicinal kohl for the Muhrim when needed, so long as it does not contain musk or camphor, and it allows a woman in ihram to use kohl except black kohl used for adornment.
